text: 本文开展系统综述；截至2026年8月30日检索PubMed，检索式为 implant[Title/Abstract] AND fibrosis[Title/Abstract]；纳入与排除标准预先确定。组织切片数据库中的标本条码——而非书目题录——经过去重，两名病理学家随后独立筛选切片，标本流程图列出导入、筛选和排除的条码数量。
gold_reason: 去重、筛选和流程数量的对象均是标本条码或组织切片，文本还明确排除了书目题录；三项文献选择结构仍缺失。

text:
We conducted a systematic review. MEDLINE was searched through 30 August 2026 using hydrogel$.ti,ab. AND implant$.ti,ab. Reports were eligible when they described prospective implantation.

The citation files exported by the database were retained as the review's record set.

After merging, this bibliographic set was deduplicated. Two reviewers independently screened its titles, abstracts, and full texts, and a PRISMA diagram accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: The later this bibliographic set has an explicit citation-file antecedent. Deduplication, title/abstract/full-text screening, and PRISMA accounting therefore apply to literature records; this is the positive control for R6-01.

text: The final article is a structured narrative review built from purposive examples and does not claim comprehensive coverage. During revision, an editor had written the comment This systematic review needs a meta-analysis; the authors rejected that characterization, and no record-based systematic synthesis was performed.
gold_reason: The unquoted phrase This systematic review belongs to an attributed editor comment, is explicitly rejected, and is followed by a denial of implementation. The final self-description is structured narrative.

text: The preregistration described a meta-analysis, but it was cancelled before any literature search or quantitative pooling began. The completed manuscript is a critical review organized around competing mechanistic explanations.
gold_reason: Meta-analysis describes a cancelled preregistration and no search or pooling was implemented. Critical review is outside the supported strict ontology, so conservative output is unspecified rather than the superseded meta-analysis.

text: This paper is a state-of-the-art review. Web of Science and Embase were searched through 27 August 2026; Web of Science used TS=(hydrogel AND fibrosis), and Embase used 'hydrogel'/exp AND 'fibrosis'/exp. Eligibility criteria were prespecified, bibliographic records were deduplicated, and two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts. A study-selection diagram enumerates records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: State-of-the-art review is an explicit but unsupported type. Its rich method signals should be extracted, while a zero strict exit means only that the current type gate is not applicable.

text: We conducted a systematic review. MEDLINE was searched through 27 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were prespecified; bibliographic records were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA flow chart accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded. In a separate rheometer export, samples were filtered with hydrogel*.tw.; the suffix .tw. meant torque-weighted signal and was not a bibliographic search field.
gold_reason: Although hydrogel*.tw. resembles Ovid syntax, the sentence binds it to a rheometer export, defines .tw. as torque-weighted, and explicitly says it is not bibliographic. The review query remains absent.

text:
We conducted a systematic review. Scopus was searched through 27 August 2026, and the exact platform command follows in the next paragraph.

TITLE-ABS-KEY((hydrogel W/3 scaffold) AND osseointegration)

Reports were eligible when they measured tissue integration. Search exports were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a record flow diagram lists records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: An explicit cross-paragraph pointer binds the standalone TITLE-ABS-KEY/W/3 command to Scopus. The literature-selection record is otherwise complete.

text: We conducted a systematic review. Embase was searched through 27 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were prespecified; bibliographic records were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA diagram accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded. No post-acceptance deposit is planned because Supplementary Data S10 is already included with this submission and gives every platform-specific search command and its execution date.
gold_reason: The future-looking phrase is negated. Already included with this submission, every platform-specific command, and execution date unambiguously describe a current supplementary search record.

text: We conducted a systematic review. CINAHL was searched through 27 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were prespecified; bibliographic records were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA diagram accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded. The manuscript cites Search Appendix S11, but that appendix remains embargoed, is not part of the submitted files, and is intended for release next year with the database commands and run dates.
gold_reason: A citation to an appendix does not establish current availability. Embargoed, not part of the submitted files, and intended for release next year make the record future or missing.

text:
This narrative review searched Scopus through 26 August 2026. Studies were chosen to contrast prospective and retrospective validation, and the account is not exhaustive.

An author-maintained Zotero full-text library supplied additional records.

Quarterly society emails and institutional-repository feeds had populated the library from 2016 through 2024.

Only items meeting the review's same inclusion rule entered the synthesis, and the originating alert or URL was retained for every item.
gold_reason: Author-maintained Zotero full-text library is a natural synonym for an author-curated collection. Source streams, 2016-2024 formation window, identical entry rule, and item-level provenance are disclosed across adjacent paragraphs.

text: This narrative review searched PubMed through 26 August 2026 and selected representative prospective experiments rather than an exhaustive census. Publisher platforms and DOI landing pages were consulted together; these resources supplied article PDFs, author metadata, and correction notices.
gold_reason: The collective phrase these resources assigns a mixed bundle of PDF and verification functions to both sources without saying which source performed which role. Both role flags should remain conservative and a role clarification should be requested.

text:
This structured narrative review searched Web of Science through 26 August 2026. Search vocabulary was organized into eight concept families—biomaterial; hydrogel; polymer; lipid nanoparticle; peptide; machine learning; active learning; multi-fidelity—and was not a database-ready query. We prioritized studies with prospective validation and used them as illustrative cases rather than an exhaustive corpus.

Because the cases were purposively selected, counts of reported limitations are not interpreted as the prevalence of those limitations across the field.
gold_reason: The eight semicolon-separated families are an explicitly non-rerunnable vocabulary inventory. The first boundary limits corpus coverage; the second limits field-wide prevalence inference, so they are complementary rather than a repeated disclaimer.
